thesis: AAPL's bullish tape is a busy-name mirage — net flow only +$17.4M at 0.53 call ask-frac [FLOW:insights_deep_dive], the 7/2 310C is a 49.5/50.5 spread, and the dark-pool buy skew is a 23-second closing-cross artifact [DP:extended_hours] — while dealers are long gamma with a +$109M wall pinning spot at 310 [STRUCT:gex]. Overbought (RSI 78.85) at the 52W high after +24% [HIST:rsi fz] with insiders selling (MSPR -100) into a crowded-long, 0.95%-SI tape, inside a TRANSITIONAL reduce-size/range regime [MACRO:MarketRegime_2026-05-27]. Not a directional long — a range-to-fade-strength setup; harvest the 310 pin with defined risk, do not chase.
